# Code of conduct

Be respectful, specific, and constructive.

Project spaces do not permit harassment, personal attacks, threats,
discriminatory conduct, deliberate disruption, or publication of
another person's private information.

Technical disagreement is welcome. Focus criticism on code, evidence,
reproducible behavior, and project scope rather than the person making
the contribution.

Maintainers may edit, hide, lock, or remove disruptive content and may
restrict participation when necessary to protect the project and its
contributors.

Report sensitive conduct concerns privately through the repository
owner's GitHub profile or GitHub's private reporting features. Do not
post private details publicly.
